JointLimits.description: The limits of each value in order: [min, max] (degrees or mm, or expressions), or null for a value without limits. Not more pairs than the joint has values.

anyOf.description: The name of a joint origin.

axis.description: The axis to sit on: "X", "Y" or "Z", "o:<ids>/origin/<item>" (a placement's origin axis), a construction axis's name, or an axis definition object.

body.description: The body a face name is on.

circle.description: The centre of a round end: a point [x, y, z] on its wall, rim or centre, or the round face's name.

corner.description: An edge origin: a point near one end of the edge, for the corner there.

edge.description: A point [x, y, z] on an edge of a planar face.

end.description: A circle's end: the name of the face across its rim there.

face.description: The centre of a planar face: a point on it [x, y, z], or its name.

frame.description: An explicit frame {origin: [x, y, z], z: [x, y, z], x?: [x, y, z]}.

occurrence.description: The occurrence the origin is on, by id or name. Default: found from the point, or the named face's component.

on.description: An edge origin: a point on the face to use.

path.description: The placement picked, as occurrence ids from the top of the assembly down to occurrence: says which copy of a sub-assembly placed more than once.

plane.description: The plane to sit on: "XY", "XZ" or "YZ" (the design's own), "o:<ids>/origin/<item>" (a placement's origin plane), a construction plane's name, or a plane definition object.

x.description: The frame's turn about z: a direction [x, y, z], a face's name or {face: [x, y, z]}.

z.description: The frame's z axis, a direction [x, y, z], where it is not the face's normal.

JointOriginArg.description: A joint origin: the name of a joint origin made with joint.origin, or an object that says where it is, in world coordinates. Give one of face, circle, edge, point, plane or axis (a point [x, y, z]; for face and circle also a face's name; a plane or axis by name or definition object), or a frame {origin, z, x?}.

JointType.description: A joint's type: rigid, revolute (turns), slider (slides), cylindrical (both), pin_slot, planar or ball; or a relation that ties only some directions or points, made where the parts are: parallel, perpendicular, angle, point_on_plane, point_on_line or line_on_plane. Case, spaces, `_` and `-` are ignored, and rotate, slide, square, point_on_face, point_on_axis and line_on_face are also taken.

JointValue.description: A number (degrees for an angle, mm for a distance; below 1e9 in size), or an expression (text) over the design's parameters, such as "width / 2" or "30 deg".

JointValues.description: A list of values, one for each of the joint's coordinates in order (the angle first for a cylindrical joint). Angles in degrees, distances in mm, or expressions.

OccurrencePath.description: An exact placement path: 1 to 64 occurrence ids from the root down.

input.description:
Add a joint between two occurrences, mated at two joint origins, and re-solve. A relation type
(parallel, perpendicular, angle, point_on_plane, point_on_line, line_on_plane) ties only some
directions or points and is made where the parts are. An expression given for `offset`,
`angle` or a value is kept with the joint and worked out again whenever the design changes. The
joint starts at its values inside its limits, and a part moved to a limit is said so in
`warnings`. One undo step.

a.description:
Side a: a joint origin, as an object in world coordinates or a joint origin's name. The
two sides must be on different occurrences.

angle.description:
The turn about that distance, in degrees or an expression; for an angle relation, its tilt
from mated. Default: none, or a half turn where that turns b less, so faces that already
meet stay as they are.

b.description: Side b: a joint origin, as `a`.

flip.description:
Whether b's z lies along a's instead of against it. Default: false (the origins are mated,
b's z against a's as two faces meet); true keeps two origins given at one point with the
same z and x as they are. A point origin without x takes its x from z, so give x on both,
or use joint.as_built, to keep a turned part where it is.

limits.description:
The limits of each value: [min, max] pairs, with null for a value without limits. Default:
none.

name.description:
The joint's name. Default: its type, `Joint` and the first number no joint's name has.
Blank text gives the default.

offset.description: The distance from a's frame to b's along z, in mm or an expression. Default: 0.

quiet.description: Leave out `dof` and `fixed` in the reply. Default: false.

value.description:
One value, for the joint's first coordinate, when `values` is not a list. Ignored (and not
checked) when `values` is a list.

values.description:
The joint's values to start at: one per coordinate (angles in degrees, distances in mm, or
expressions the joint then follows). Default: 0 for each, or for a relation or a joint that
closes a loop, where the parts are. Wins over `value`.

input.title: CreateJointParams

label: Joint

JointProblem.description: A joint the solve reports: its id, name and why.

why.description: Why it conflicts or could not be applied.

OccurrenceDof.description: The degrees of freedom one occurrence keeps (6 free, 0 fixed).

occurrence.description: The occurrence, by id (0 is the root).

output.description: What `joint.create` and `joint.as_built` return: the solve after the joint is added.

conflicts.description: The joints that disagree with the placement found through others.

dof.description: Each occurrence's remaining degrees of freedom (6 free, 0 fixed). Left out with `quiet`.

errors.description: The joints that could not be applied (a lost origin, an expression that no longer works).

fixed.description: The occurrences fixed in place (grounded, or the root), by id. Left out with `quiet`.

param_warnings.description: In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.

warnings.description:
A value that starts inside its limits, not where it was given: the part moved there as it
was joined. Left out when there is none.

output.title: JointAddedResult

params: type: rigid|revolute|slider|cylindrical|pin_slot|planar|ball, or a relation: parallel|perpendicular|angle|point_on_plane|point_on_line|line_on_plane (ties only some directions or points, made where the parts are; several between two parts add up); a, b: joint origins ({occurrence, face|circle|edge|point: [x,y,z] in world, or face|circle: "<face name>", plane: "XY"|"o:<ids>/origin/<item>"|"<name>", axis: "Z"|"o:<ids>/origin/<item>"|"<name>"; z? for a point, end?, x? as joint.origin} | origin name); values?: [angles in deg or expressions, distances]; limits?: [[min, max] | null…]; flip?: bool (default false: the origins are mated, b's z against a's as two faces meet - two plane or axis datums mate aligned, each part keeping its side of the datum, and flip mates them; true: b's z along a's, so two origins given at one point with the same z and x stay as they are; a point origin without x takes its x from z, so give x on both, or use joint.as_built, to keep a turned part where it is); offset?: mm or an expression; angle?: deg or an expression (an angle relation's tilt from mated; for other joints the default is none, or a half turn where that turns b less, so faces that already meet stay as they are); name?; quiet?: bool (leave out dof and fixed). An expression (text) is kept with the joint and worked out again whenever the design changes, so the joint follows the parameters it names; a joint whose expression no longer works out (a parameter deleted) is left out of the solve with the reason in its errors
